keyPoints: Samaan sanrachana wali aur samaan kaam karne wali koshikaon ka samooh uttak (tissue) kehlata hai; kayi uttak milkar ang banate hain.
Paudhon me vibhajyotak (meristematic) uttak lagatar vibhajit hokar vriddhi karta hai, jabki sthayi uttak (permanent) sahara, suraksha aur parivahan dete hain.
Xylem nalikaen jadon se paani-khanij pattiyon tak pahunchati hain, phloem pattiyon me bana bhojan paudhe ke har hisse tak pahunchata hai.
Jantuon me upkala (epithelial) uttak sharir ko dhakta aur raksha karta hai, peshi (muscular) uttak sikudkar gati deta hai.
Tantrika uttak (nervous tissue) sandeshon ko tez gati se pahunchata hai, jabki asthi (bone) aur rakt sanyoji uttak hain jo jodte aur dhote hain.
Rakt ek drav sanyoji uttak hai jo oxygen, bhojan, hormone aur bekar padarth ko sharir me idhar-udhar pahunchata hai.
Aam galti: uttak aur ang ko ek samajhna; uttak koshikaon ka samooh hai, jabki ang (jaise hriday ya patti) kayi prakaar ke uttakon se milkar banta hai.
